root_cause: The dropdown remains open when focus leaves the navigation via Tab because there is no focusout handler to close the menu.
repair_strategy: Add a focusout listener on the top-level menu element that closes any open submenu toggles and the controller when focus leaves the menu.
expected_accessibility_effect: When a user tabs out of the navigation, the Shop dropdown will close, preventing it from covering page content.
functional_risks: If focus moves to an element outside the menu that is not a descendant (e.g., a modal or dialog), the dropdown will close as intended.
Potential premature closure if a custom widget steals focus without being a DOM descendant of the menu.
May interfere with other scripts that manage focus if they also listen for focusout on the menu.
verification_requirements: Tabbing from Shop button to Plants, Tools, then Search input results in Shop's aria-expanded becoming false and Plants hidden.
Navigating within the menu (e.g., Shop → Plants → Tools → Shop via Shift+Tab) keeps the dropdown open.
Clicking outside the menu with the mouse still closes the dropdown (existing behavior).
Pressing Escape while the dropdown is open closes it and returns focus to the Shop button (as per regression guard).
Optional arrow key navigation (if enabled) continues to work after the fix.
